arguments.message: Sure! To fire a sample webhook event on demand, go to **Settings → Developer → Webhooks** in the Meridian dashboard and click **Send test event**. This sends a realistic payload (using the same schema, headers, and signing header as a live delivery) to the endpoint you’ve configured, so you can verify your handler works before any real traffic. The test delivery will also appear in the delivery log, marked as a test event.
